alignment_denominator: all attempted rounds; primary selected card only; malformed/absent counted as nonaligned, empty selection counted as nonaligned open structure; report coverage separately
card_catalog: all C01-C10 every round, order random.Random(f"{env}:{rep}:{round}"), shared by the three arms
controlled_comparison_rule: True-Z directional alignment must strictly exceed each comparison arm over all 24 attempts; holdout support requires both envs vs both arms R-mean CF common-day CI upper < 0 and point NLL/exhaust deltas <= .005/.05. Report descriptive alignment separately; if both support then SUPPORTED_WITH_BOUNDARY, if one supports PARTIAL, if both envs vs both CF CI lower > 0 REFUTED, otherwise INCONCLUSIVE. 2 independent search trajectories per cell; day-bootstrap CIs condition on these realized trajectories, not a search-population inference.
holdout_rule: materialize 12 independent days only after all 72 slots consumed and all 12 trajectories finished and approved source hashes frozen; reuse trained models, oracle does not feed search. Same registered dates as historical M3/M3.1; unseen by this search, not novel relative to them. Transplant and search evaluations use independent work roots.
loop2_transplant_rule: Zero API calls. Extract all unique non-B0 final promoted winners across trajectories plus any valid open-innovation (selected_card_ids == []) candidate whose target_metric paired dev 95% CI is wholly negative; seal transplant-freeze.json before opening any single-factor holdout; refit unchanged in mapped P2-M2 single-factor pair and test delta_tau = tau(z_strong) - tau(z_weak) on target_metric (BOUNDARY_CONFIRMED if 95% CI wholly < 0 and tau(z_strong) < 0; BOUNDARY_REFUTED if 95% CI wholly > 0; else INCONCLUSIVE).
prediction_rule: candidate-parent 95% paired day CI wholly predicted side supports, opposite side refutes; crossing zero or absent CI inconclusive; no evaluated candidate non-evaluable
prior_posterior_rule: Offline only, per environment/card, Beta(1,1). Count a VALID numerically converged candidate once for each explicitly selected card; multi-card candidates contribute shared evidence, not isolated causal attribution. n_valid includes inconclusive or unavailable CI. n_plus if target-metric candidate-minus-parent paired-day 95% CI wholly negative; n_minus if wholly positive; otherwise neither; all target metrics lower is better, irrespective of declared direction verdict. Posterior mean=(1+n_plus)/(2+n_plus+n_minus).

promotion.objective_improvement: CF paired estimate with >=6 common valid days decides
promotion.viability_recovery: CF support <6 common days: guardrails, dExhaust<=-0.10, and surviving point dCF<=+0.50 when present

provider.response_cache: none between logical call slots; durable receipt replay only within the same slot after interruption
provider.sampling: provider-native stochastic reasoning; omit unsupported explicit temperature and seed

regret_rule: holdout CF MAE of final minus minimum over B0 and all valid evaluated candidates, on same intersection of finite paired days across oracle set; require >=6 days; no imputation
replicate_summary_rule: Report per-track effects and descriptive mean/sample SD over all 2 separate estimates; R-mean day bootstrap uses only days with finite effects in all 2 trajectories, shared day draws; pooled world contrast requires both worlds per day/replicate and weights worlds equally; no R×day pseudo-replication.
